name: hcapp_getCoRunners
description: Run Counts > By Hasher (E10.F1.S5): everyone the caller has run with (both attended), most runs together first. The per-kennel counts come from HC6.CoRunnerKennels(@userId) once, into a temp table; the totals, first/last run together and the 'mostly <kennel>' are all read from it (calling HC6.CoRunners as well worked the whole thing out twice). The caller's OWN history, so a hasher who chose 'nobody' for search still appears (James, 2026-10-02). The whole list in one reply (~760 rows for James, ~60 ms); the app searches it locally. Read-only. Auth: HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber 144, @param NULL).

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device. Default NULL (a NULL is refused by ValidateAppAuth as 'Device not registered').

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived token (standard, device secret). Default NULL.

rowsets.description: Auth failure only, returned alone (no compact envelope); runtime errors are logged and re-thrown.

rowsets.name: CoRunners
rowsets.description: On success: one row per co-runner who is not deleted or removed, ORDER BY RunsTogether DESC, LastTogether DESC. Empty for a hasher with no shared runs.

columns.name: PublicHasherId
columns.description: UPPER(CAST(Hasher.PublicHasherId AS NVARCHAR(40))); the app lowercases it on arrival.

columns.name: DisplayName
columns.description: Hasher.DisplayName — the hasher's own display choice (persisted computed column).

columns.name: HomeKennelShortName
columns.description: Kennel.KennelShortName of the co-runner's home kennel (LEFT JOIN on Hasher.HomeKennelId, deleted = 0); NULL when they have none.

columns.name: HomeKennelLogo
columns.description: Kennel.KennelLogo of the home kennel; NULL when none.

columns.name: RunsTogether
columns.description: SUM of CoRunnerKennels.RunsTogether across kennels — runs both attended.

columns.name: LastTogether
columns.description: MAX(LastTogether): EventStartDatetimeGmt of the latest run together, an instant.

columns.name: FirstTogether
columns.description: MIN(FirstTogether): EventStartDatetimeGmt of the first run together (added 2026-10-02).

columns.name: MostlyKennelShortName
columns.description: KennelShortName of the kennel where the two ran together most (ROW_NUMBER over RunsTogether DESC, LastTogether DESC — ties go to the most recent). Added 2026-10-02.

sideEffects: Creates a session temp table #ck (line 51) for the duration of the call.
INSERT HC.ErrorLog then THROW on an unhandled error (CATCH, line 74).

codeSmells.detail: Line 54 returns PublicHasherId as UPPER(...). Ids are lowercase everywhere in the app; this relies on the adHoc reply door lowercasing it.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
